boundary_decision.rationale: The slash label is resolved as a return declaration and filing-process aggregate. It owns the versioned declaration package, filing attempts and authority acknowledgements, while taxpayers, tax accounts, substantive law, assessments, payments, refunds, audits, disputes and records remain external masters.

decisions.rationale: The model owns declaration revisions, filing attempts and acknowledgements, not every upstream tax fact or downstream authority and payment lifecycle.
The unified registry supplies WM-POL-011 as a parent hint but the frozen relation ledger has no settled WM-ECO-032 edge, so it grants no containment or cascade authority.

decisions.concept: Return revision, filing attempt and acknowledgement
decisions.rationale: A revision declares facts, an attempt transmits a particular payload and an acknowledgement records a correlated channel or authority response.

decisions.concept: Prepared, signed, submitted, received, valid, accepted, assessed and paid
decisions.rationale: No preparation, signature, transport, validation or processing state silently proves a later authority determination or settlement.

decisions.concept: Reported value, declared tax, assessed liability, payment and refund
decisions.rationale: Every value preserves type, currency, rule version, period, source and derivation and cannot prove a separate authority or transaction record.

decisions.concept: Original, amended, corrected, superseding, supplemental, final, nil and information return
decisions.rationale: Each class has distinct legal effect, validation, lineage and downstream processing and cannot be inferred from filename or sequence alone.
The original filed revision remains immutable while a successor states change set, reason, authority and downstream impact.

decisions.concept: Taxpayer, account, law, assessment, payment, refund, audit, dispute and enforcement
decisions.rationale: The return may bind or project data to these models but does not absorb their identity, authority or lifecycle.

decisions.concept: Jurisdiction, tax type, form, schema and filing channel
decisions.rationale: Official sources define scoped regimes and releases; no form, deadline, calculation, signature or acceptance rule is universal.

decisions.concept: Tax secrecy, privacy, access and segregation
decisions.rationale: Taxpayer identity, return facts, income, deductions, bank data, signatures, assessments and disputes require purpose-bound least privilege and auditable exceptions.
XML, XBRL, JSON, YAML, files, APIs and databases are projections of the same model and must pin profiles and declare loss.

decisions.concept: Single-provider waiver and local no-tools audit
decisions.rationale: One bounded Claude Sonnet and one bounded Grok attempt each timed out after 120 seconds. Codex separately audited the frozen validated result and comparison without new facts, so assurance remains reviewable-draft.

deferred_research: Canonically adjudicate the WM-POL-011 parent signal and register relations to taxpayer, account, obligation, law, invoice, payroll, payment, refund, assessment, audit, dispute, enforcement and records models.
Evaluate separate canonical tax-obligation, tax-return-revision, filing-attempt, acknowledgement, assessment, payment and refund models while preserving this aggregate as an assembly.
Create income, corporate, partnership, payroll, VAT, excise, customs, property, estate, gift, information-return, international, consolidated-group and sector profiles.
Benchmark and conformance-test forms, schemas, taxonomies, validation rules, signatures, deadlines, channels, acknowledgements, amendments and correction mappings.
Validate jurisdiction, tax-type, taxpayer-class, calculation, signature, tax-secrecy, privacy, assessment, payment, refund, audit, dispute, enforcement and retention policies.
Pin exact external releases and obtain independent tax, legal, filing, accounting, privacy, security, records and data-governance review before promotion beyond reviewable-draft assurance.
publication_holds: Absence-of-external-review hold: one Claude Sonnet and one Grok attempt for WM-ECO-032 each timed out after 120 seconds; no external result was admitted.

Slash-boundary hold: this aggregate covers return declaration revisions, filing attempts and acknowledgements, while upstream tax facts and downstream authority or transaction lifecycles remain external.
Relation hold: WM-POL-011 is only a provisional parent signal and the frozen relation ledger contains no settled WM-ECO-032 edge.
Identity hold: taxpayer, tax account, return revision, filing attempt, acknowledgement, assessment, payment, refund, dispute, enforcement and records objects remain distinct.
Lifecycle hold: prepared, validated, signed, submitted, received, schema-valid, accepted-for-processing, assessed, paid, refunded, disputed and final states do not prove one another.
Value hold: reported amount, calculated declared tax, authority-assessed liability, payment, offset and refund remain separately sourced and currency qualified.
Amendment hold: amendments, corrections, supersessions and withdrawals preserve predecessors and declare downstream obligations rather than overwriting history.
Privacy hold: taxpayer identifiers, reported facts, income, deductions, bank data, signatures, assessments and disputes require tax secrecy, purpose limitation and minimum disclosure.
Source-access hold: the prior OECD legacy resource URL failed direct retrieval and was replaced by its current official resource-centre URL verified through official indexed content.
Profile hold: income, corporate, partnership, payroll, VAT, excise, customs, property, estate, gift, information-return, international and consolidated-group uses need separate profiles.

Interoperability hold: every tax, reporting, currency, signature, temporal, provenance, quality, privacy, policy and API projection needs exact release pins, conformance evidence and loss declarations.
Review hold: tax, legal, filing, accounting, privacy, security, records and independent external review are outstanding.
